facts.fact: ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera said on 2026-09-17 that the principles of the proposed e-commerce law had been taken to Cabinet, that the Attorney-General's Office was now drafting the Bill, and that the Act was expected to be concluded by the first quarter of 2027; no Bill text is stated to be published (as_of is the conference date, the Thursday before the 2026-09-18 report).

FinMark Trust says Zimbabwe, with the DRC and Lesotho, does not have comprehensive legislation of the Electronic Transactions Act kind, and that existing financial services, data protection and cybersecurity laws are adapted instead; the document gives no event date, so as_of is its published date 2026-06-18.

TechReviewAfrica reports that an E-Commerce and E-Transactions Bill is under construction to give digital trade a legal framework, as announced by ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera at the postal and courier conference; no date of the statement is given, so the 2026-09-20 publication date is used.

Spiked Media reports that minister Tatenda Mavetera said on 2026-09-18 that government was working towards finalising the country's e-commerce and electronic transactions framework, to provide an enabling environment for secure electronic commerce.

note: E-hailing transport regulation and tax registration: class other, no e-commerce or electronic transactions law stated.
E-hailing statutory instrument under the Road Motor Transportation Act: class other, no e-commerce or electronic transactions law stated.

facts.fact: Veritas Zimbabwe says the Electronic Transactions and Electronic Commerce Bill, named in the President's October 2025 address, has not been presented in Parliament or published in the Gazette and is presumably still being drafted.

facts.fact: A first draft, dated 11 June 2013, of the Electronic Transactions and Electronic Commerce Bill exists as an ITU-assisted government draft covering legal recognition of electronic communications and signatures, electronic contracts, online consumer protection and service provider liability.
